summary: Defines the IMAP UIDONLY extension. Once enabled, the server reports mailbox changes using only Unique Identifiers (UIDs), not message numbers, and clients cannot use message numbers in requests. This saves clients and servers the effort of mapping between the two. The status is experimental.

eli5.summary: Each email has a seat number that can change and a permanent ID. This tells email programs to use only the permanent ID to avoid mix-ups.
